messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high rate of image-pull failures observed in us-west-2 (autoscaler provisioning errors). Impact: new node provisioning + some CI jobs failing. Rolling alert to #incidents.

marta: seeing this on cluster-prod-1. kubelet logs show repeated 503s from registry-1.docker.io when pulling nvidia/cuda images.

kevin: oncall here, I'm looking. can someone dump a failing pod event?

marta: pasted event from node-provisioner-xyz: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning  Failed     2m    kubelet, ip-10-0-2-45  Failed to pull image "nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime@sha256:...": received unexpected HTTP status: 503 Service Unavailable
```

sunil: also seeing CI jobs in infra-pipelines failing with: `docker pull docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1` timing out.

anya: :warning: customer-facing note: a subset of Dedicated provisioning calls are delayed. CS already flagged a couple of incoming tickets. Not yet widespread.

kevin: thanks. initial triage: sounds like Docker Hub / NVIDIA layer serving issues. first mitigation: switch node-provisioner to pull from our internal registry mirror where we cache major CUDA images. I'll start a canary patch.

marta: if we can patch the DaemonSet that does pre-pulling to use the mirror, that should unblock new nodes. patch command I'm preparing: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset node-prepull --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"registry.redwood.internal/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime"}]'
```

infra-bot: noted. created ticket INF-4723 to mirror missing tags and start async pre-pulls.

kevin: doing the patch now. will monitor the autoscaler.

(1m later)

kevin: canaries pulled successfully from our mirror. new node provisioning progressing. autoscaler creating 3 nodes, kubelet completed image pulls.

marta: logging shows removed 503s for mirror pulls. still seeing intermittent 503s when hitting docker.io directly from older nodes trying to restart pods.

kevin: schedule: keep the mirror fallback for 4 hours, then reevaluate. I'll also open a vendor escalation to Docker/NVIDIA with link to our logs. anyone with direct vendor contacts ping them now.

sunil: escalation thread created and shared with NVIDIA support. provided timestamps + sample request ids.

anya: CS update: notifying customers with potential provisioning delays. message template drafted.

ops-lead: quick customer-impact summary for execs: affect: node provisioning and non-critical CI jobs. scope: 8% of provisioning requests in us-west-2 over last 45m. customer-visible outages: low, but delays for new Dedicated allocations. recommended mitigation: mirror fallback (done), pre-pull on scale-up (done), and temporary increase in push-throughput to customers on impacted clusters if needed.

kevin: handoff: I'm taking the incident for the next 30m, then sunil will take the night handoff at 23:00 UTC. keeping channel updated.

(30m later)

sunil: taking over from @kevin. mirror fallback still active. autoscaler stable, no new provisioning errors in the last 20m.

marta: we've also added a transient node init job that pre-pulls the top 5 CUDA tags during scale-out, and updated cluster bootstrap to prefer registry.redwood.internal.

infra-bot: background job started: backfill cached images for containers listed in INF-4723. estimated completion ~2h.

kevin: vendor status: Docker Hub reported a partial API disruption impacting manifest and large layer downloads in certain regions; NVIDIA registry also having increased error rates for some layers. both teams investigating.

anya: CS sent proactive notice to 12 customers in affected regions, offering priority provisioning via manual ops if needed.

ops-lead: closing notes for postmortem: include timeline, why mirror fallback wasn't earlier enabled by default, and a runbook update to enable registry failover more quickly. assign to infra oncall to author.

sunil: will draft the incident summary and postmortem, tagging infra and sre. current status: mitigation in place, degradation cleared for provisioning, impact limited to delayed restarts and CI flakes.

marta: logs snapshot (relevant lines): 
```
Mar 15 22:12:04 kubelet[2345]: E0321 22:12:04.123456    2345 remote_image.go:234] Pulling image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime" failed: received HTTP status 503
Mar 15 22:14:11 kubelet[2345]: I0321 22:14:11.654321    2345 remote_image.go:260] Pulling image "registry.redwood.internal/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime" succeeded
```

incident-bot: Incident resolved? No active alerts for image-pull-rate in us-west-2 for 45m.

kevin: marking as resolved for now. will reopen if vendor status changes. thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
